lines.en: Let out a deep growl
Shake its body forcefully
Use tusks to dig sand
Slowly swim forward
My tusks rake through the seafloor sand.
发出警告吼叫 Issue a warning roar
Inhale through its nostrils
Expose sharp teeth
Low growl as a threat
Chase after prey shadows

lines.zh: 深蓝鳞片擦过浅滩碎石。
lines.en: Dark blue scales scrape the shallows' gravel.
My tusk flicks up a slab of wet sand.
Slowly swim and wait
Inhale through its nostril
Tap its head on the surface
Roll to relax
Gently touch the sand with its mouth
Slightly float up and down in water
Quietly observe its surroundings
Touch water plants with its nose
Slightly move water waves with its tusks
Occasionally spray water to cool down

lines.zh: 我把长牙搭在礁石上歇着。
lines.en: I rest my tusk on the reef rock.
My nostril puffs out a little mist.
The ripples push me; I push them back.

lines.zh: 我在浅水里慢慢沉下去。
lines.en: I sink slowly in the shallows.
Swiftly turn toward the player
Low growl to lock on target
Stare at the player with sharp eyes
Exhibit fierce fangs

lines.zh: 水底那声低吼，是从我喉咙里出来的。
lines.en: That low growl from the waterbed comes from my throat.
Prepare to attack the targeted player
Use tusks to aim at the player
Issue a warning sound
Touch the player with its nose
Low growl as a sign of hostility
The water bursts and I lift my head.

lines.zh: 长牙离你的腿只有一步。
lines.en: My tusk is one step from your leg.

lines.zh: 我歪头打量这个陆上生物。
lines.en: I tilt my head at this land creature.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了我要找的那块骨。
lines.en: You crushed the bone I was hunting for.
The shadow on the bank puts me on guard.

lines.zh: 水下，我的眼睛亮了一下。
lines.en: Underwater, my eyes glint.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上没有海味。
lines.en: You smell of no sea at all.

lines.zh: 我把长牙对准你的方向。
lines.en: I level my tusk toward you.

lines.zh: 长牙受了伤，它的牙齿在滴血。
lines.en: Blubbertusk is injured, its tusks are bleeding.

lines.zh: 受伤了，长牙的皮肤开始裂开。
lines.en: Blubbertusk is hurt, its skin is starting to tear.

lines.zh: 长牙的伤痕让它痛苦不已。
lines.en: Blubbertusk's wounds are causing it agony.

lines.zh: 长牙的伤口在流血，看起来很严重。
lines.en: Blubbertusk's wounds are bleeding badly.
Blubbertusk is howling in pain.

lines.zh: 受伤的长牙变得怒气冲冲。
lines.en: The injured Blubbertusk is furious.

lines.zh: 长牙被自己的伤口吓到了。
lines.en: Blubbertusk is scared by its own wounds.

lines.zh: 它的伤势让长牙的皮肤都变了色。
lines.en: Its wounds are changing the color of Blubbertusk's skin.
Blubbertusk is roaring in pain.

lines.zh: 长牙的伤口在缓慢愈合。
lines.en: Blubbertusk's wounds are slowly healing.

lines.zh: 咔嚓！它的獠牙在月光下闪耀。
lines.en: Crash! Its tusks glint in the moonlight.
It smells prey nearby.

lines.zh: 它的皮肤布满了深蓝色的鳞片。
lines.en: Its skin is covered in dark blue scales.

lines.zh: 你手里那块肉，晃得我眼馋。
lines.en: That meat in your hand sways and tempts me.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的叫声，寻求食物。
lines.en: It emits a deep call, seeking food.

lines.zh: 它的触手缠绕在石头上。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around the rocks.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴轻轻拍打着水面。
lines.en: Its tail gently slaps the water.

lines.zh: 它在水中潜行，寻找猎物。
lines.en: It swims silently, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 它咬下一块肉，露出锋利的牙齿。
lines.en: It bites a piece of meat, revealing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 它的触手突然收紧，抓住了猎物。
lines.en: Its tentacles suddenly tighten, grabbing prey.

lines.zh: 巨大的头颅撞击在石墙上。
lines.en: Its massive head crashes into the stone wall.
Its body bumps against the rock.
It forcefully collides with the water surface.
Its tusks smash through obstacles.

lines.zh: 它从岩石中撞出一条路。
lines.en: It forces a path through the rocks.
The impact echoes through the valley.
Its tentacles tangle together.
It forcefully collides, trying to escape.

lines.zh: 撞击让周围的水花四溅。
lines.en: The collision splashes water everywhere.

lines.zh: 它猛烈地撞击着前方的敌人。
lines.en: It fiercely collides with the enemy in front.

lines.zh: 它们围绕着发出交配叫声。
lines.en: They circle, making mating calls.

lines.zh: 雄性长牙海兽发出求偶叫声。
lines.en: The male Blubbertusk makes a mating call.

lines.zh: 雌性回应着雄性的求偶声。
lines.en: The female responds to the male's call.

lines.zh: 它们发出低沉的求偶声。
lines.en: They emit deep mating calls.
The mating calls echo in the water.

lines.zh: 雄性展示獠牙吸引雌性。
lines.en: The male displays its tusks to attract the female.

lines.zh: 雌性也展示自己的魅力。
lines.en: The female also displays her allure.
They swim away after mating.
The male and female mate.

lines.zh: 它们互相碰撞，表示同意。
lines.en: They bump into each other, indicating agreement.

lines.zh: 长牙在水下发出嘶嘶声，仿佛要吞噬一切。
lines.en: The longtooth hisses underwater, as if to swallow everything.

lines.zh: 水面上露出长牙，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Long teeth protrude from the water, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 它在黑暗中游动，寻找下一个猎物。
lines.en: It swims in the darkness, searching for its next meal.

lines.zh: 听到水波声，它准备攻击。
lines.en: It readies itself for an attack upon hearing the water's ripple.

lines.zh: 它的眼中闪烁着饥饿的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glint with hunger.

lines.zh: 长牙在水下追逐着鱼类。
lines.en: The longtooth chases fish underwater.

lines.zh: 它吐出一股水柱，准备吓退敌人。
lines.en: It spits a water jet, ready to scare off enemies.

lines.zh: 长牙感受到附近的威胁，迅速潜入水中。
lines.en: The longtooth senses a threat nearby and quickly dives underwater.

lines.zh: 它用长牙攻击附近的生物。
lines.en: It attacks nearby creatures with its long tusks.
It rumbles underwater.
It locks onto the player from afar.
It stealthily approaches, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 猎物的气味让它兴奋起来。
lines.en: The prey's scent excites it.

lines.zh: 它在水面之下观察着目标。
lines.en: It observes the target underwater.

lines.zh: 它感受到玩家的存在，准备出击。
lines.en: It senses the player's presence and prepares to strike.
It locks on to its prey with its eyes.

lines.zh: 它的注意力被玩家吸引。
lines.en: Its attention is drawn to the player.
It begins to stealthily stalk the player.
It locks on to the player's position.

lines.zh: 水面下的影子，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the shadow under the water.

lines.zh: 我的鼻孔记住了你的味道。
lines.en: My nostrils have your scent now.

lines.zh: 浅滩上的动静引来我的注意。
lines.en: The stir in the shallows draws my eye.

lines.zh: 一具新鲜的骨在岸上走。
lines.en: A fresh set of bones walks the shore.
I adjust the angle of my tusk.
You step into the pit I dug in the sand.
I decide to follow this one.
It aims with its long tusks.

lines.zh: 它准备用骨牙攻击玩家。
lines.en: It prepares to attack with its bone tusks.

lines.zh: 它从水中跃起，攻击玩家。
lines.en: It leaps from the water to attack the player.
It targets the player's weak points.
It pierces the player with its bone tusks.

lines.zh: 它将长牙插入玩家的身体。
lines.en: It impales the player with its long tusks.

lines.zh: 它用骨牙划破玩家的皮肤。
lines.en: It slices the player with its bone tusks.
It targets the player's head.
It throws its long tusks at the player.

lines.zh: 它用骨牙穿透玩家的盔甲。
lines.en: It penetrates the player's armor with its bone tusks.

lines.zh: 我的长牙压低，对准水下。
lines.en: My tusk lowers, aimed beneath the surface.
My tail slaps and the surface bursts.
I count your steps from the waterline.
Muscle tightens under the dark blue scales.

lines.zh: 你的落脚处太靠近深水。
lines.en: You stand too close to deep water.

lines.zh: 长牙划开泥沙，我来找你。
lines.en: My tusks split the silt; I am coming for you.
My tusk points at the back of your knee.
The weeds have blocked your retreat.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的咆哮，獠牙闪烁着寒光。
lines.en: Rumbles with low growls, fangs glistening.

lines.zh: 用獠牙撕裂猎物，鲜血飞溅。
lines.en: Rips prey with fangs, spraying blood.
Roars and charges at the target.

lines.zh: 用巨大身躯撞击，震碎骨头。
lines.en: Uses massive body to collide, shattering bones.
Long tusks pierce enemy's chest.

lines.zh: 咬碎猎物的肌肉，露出白骨。
lines.en: Bites flesh off prey, exposing bones.
Fangs pierce, blood spurts.

lines.zh: 猛力撞击，敌人骨骼碎裂。
lines.en: Collides hard, splintering bones.

lines.zh: 用獠牙撕裂敌人的喉咙。
lines.en: Gapes throat with fangs.
Tusks pierce enemy's stomach.
My tusk runs through your shoulder!
I flip you with a headbutt!
My dark blue tail whips your waist!
I drag you into the shallows!
A tusk rips your leggings open!

lines.zh: 水花里，我咬住你的手臂！
lines.en: In the spray, I bite your arm!
Rises slowly from the sea.
Dives deep, waiting.
Roams near shore rocks.
Navigates underwater caves.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中游弋，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Swims in darkness, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 从洞穴中钻出，注视四周。
lines.en: Emerges from cave, eyes on surroundings.

lines.zh: 在潮汐间穿行，潜伏等待。
lines.en: Wades through tides, lurking.

lines.zh: 在礁石上休息，伺机出击。
lines.en: Reposes on reefs, ready to strike.
Peers from deep cracks.
Patrols edge of coast.
The shallows swell upward.
I lift my tusk out of the mud.

lines.zh: 礁石后传来湿重的呼吸。
lines.en: Wet, heavy breathing comes from behind the reef.
A dark blue back breaks the surface.

lines.zh: 潮水退去，我留在了岸上。
lines.en: The tide pulls back and leaves me ashore.
A dark shape joins the weeds.

lines.zh: 我把岸边的骨翻得咔咔响。
lines.en: I turn the shore bones over with a clatter.

lines.zh: 鼻孔一张，空气里全是我的味道。
lines.en: My nostrils flare, and the air fills with my stink.
The fire has blackened Blubbertusk.

lines.zh: 长牙从高处摔落，伤势严重。
lines.en: Blubbertusk fell from a high place, badly injured.

lines.zh: 长牙在溺水中挣扎，受伤了。
lines.en: Blubbertusk is struggling to breathe, injured by drowning.

lines.zh: 爆炸冲击让长牙的伤口裂开。
lines.en: The explosion has caused Blubbertusk's wounds to tear open.
Blubbertusk is hit by an arrow, injured.

lines.zh: 魔法攻击让长牙伤痕累累。
lines.en: Blubbertusk is covered in wounds from magic attacks.

lines.zh: 长牙因饥饿而虚弱受伤。
lines.en: Blubbertusk is weak from starvation and injury.

lines.zh: 雷击让长牙的皮肉烧伤。
lines.en: Lightning struck Blubbertusk, burning its skin.

lines.zh: 虚空的撕裂伤让长牙鲜血直流。
lines.en: The void's tearing has left Blubbertusk bleeding.
